DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録住所の見直しですね。引越しではなく、いまの情報の修正をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check your registered address. Is this a correction to your current information rather than a move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、同じ場所に住んでいます。画面にはマンション名まで出ていますが、私の部屋番号がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居と登録の修正を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I still live in the same place. The screen shows the apartment building's name, but my room number is missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish moving home from correcting registered information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこで抜けたかは、入力内容を見ないとわかりません。いまお持ちの住所表記には部屋番号もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot tell where it was omitted without looking at the information entered. Does the address you have with you include the room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この書類には三百二号室まで載っています。住所は変わっていないので、修正だけ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正しい部屋番号を照合できる資料を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This document includes room 302. My address has not changed, so I only want to ask about correcting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention the document that can be used to check the correct room number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者が確認できるよう、書類をお出しください。画面には建物名と部屋番号の欄が分かれているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please present the document so the staff member can check it. The screen may have separate fields for the building name and room number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 建物名の欄に全部入れるのだと思っていました。別の欄があるなら、どちらに番号を書くか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一つの欄にまとめる思い込みを解消する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought everything went in the building name field. If there is another field, I would like to check where the number should go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clear up the assumption that everything belongs in one field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 画面の案内と照らし合わせてご説明します。入力できても、申請完了の表示まで確認することが必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain it by referring to the screen's instructions. Even if you can enter the information, you need to check that the application completion message appears.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 保存ボタンを押しただけで終わりと思わず、完了したか確かめます。受付後に修正内容を見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 修正の受付と確認手段を把握する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume I am finished just because I pressed Save; I will check whether it is complete. Can I view the correction after it has been accepted?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Find out how the correction is accepted and how to check it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる画面や書面があるか担当者にお尋ねください。お持ちの郵便物についても、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the staff member whether there is a screen or a written document you can check. Do you also have any questions about the mail you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 以前届いた封筒に部屋番号がなかったので、その封筒も見せます。これからの送付先がどうなるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録画面と郵便表記をつなげて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: An envelope I received earlier had no room number, so I will show that too. I want to check what address future mail will be sent to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss both the registered address on screen and the address printed on mail. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書類と封筒を一緒にお持ちなら、状況を伝えやすいですね。修正の案内を受けてから、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Having both the document and envelope will make the situation easier to explain. After you receive instructions for the correction, please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ソースのラベルを見ていらっしゃいますね。保存の表示で気になる点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the sauce label. Is there anything in the storage instructions that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表には常温とありますが、裏には冷蔵という字があります。旅行へ持っていきたいので、どちらなのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行へ持参するため常温と冷蔵の関係を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The front says room temperature, but the back says refrigerated. I want to take it on a trip, so I do not know which applies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Understand how room-temperature and refrigerated storage relate before taking it on a trip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このラベルでは、常温は未開封の保存方法の欄です。裏の冷蔵は開封後の欄に書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this label, room temperature is in the instructions for storage before opening. Refrigeration on the back is in the after-opening section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開ける前と後で違うのですね。旅先で使い始める予定ですが、泊まる部屋には冷蔵庫がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旅先で保管できるか検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is different before and after opening. I plan to start using it during the trip, but the room where I am staying has no refrigerator.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Consider whether you can store it at your destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、開封後に表示どおり保管できるかを考えてから選びましょう。大きい瓶より少量の品を探されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, choose after considering whether you can follow the label's storage instructions after opening. Would you like to look for a smaller quantity rather than a large bottle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい物も見たいです。それから魚の風味が苦手なので、原材料に魚があるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 量と味の好みに合う候補を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to see smaller ones too. Also, I dislike fish flavor, so I want to check whether the ingredients include fish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Look for options that suit your preferred quantity and taste. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原材料の欄はここです。ただ、名前だけで味の強さは判断できません。似た容器でも中身は違うので、一つずつ見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The ingredients section is here. However, the name alone does not tell you how strong the flavor is. Similar containers can hold different things, so check each one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この瓶と小さい袋は同じソースだと思っていました。それぞれの原材料と保存欄を読み比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ容器の印象で中身を判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought this bottle and the small pouch contained the same sauce. I will compare their ingredients and storage sections.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not judge the contents from the impression given by similar packaging. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示でわからない保管の条件は、メーカーへ確認する方法もあります。冷蔵庫がない間の日持ちは、ここで保証できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also ask the manufacturer about storage conditions that are unclear on the label. We cannot guarantee here how long it will keep without a refrigerator.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日持ちを決めつけず、旅行中に保管できる物だけ選びます。読めない条件が残れば、今日は買うのを見送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認できない日持ちに頼って購入しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not assume how long it will keep; I will choose only something I can store during the trip. If any conditions remain unreadable to me, I will put off buying it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not buy based on an unconfirmed assumption about shelf life. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 旅先での使い方まで考えて選べましたね。表示を確かめながら、ごゆっくりお買い物なさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have considered how you will use it on your trip as well. Please take your time shopping and checking the labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 三人で散歩されるのですね。皆さん同じくらいの距離を歩くご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The three of you are going for a walk. Are you all planning to walk about the same distance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は長く歩きたいのですが、友人の一人は短い散歩にしたいそうです。途中で離ればなれにはなりたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者の違いを散歩計画の条件にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want a long walk, but one of my friends would prefer a short one. I do not want us to get separated along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Take your companions' differing preferences into account in the walking plan. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の花壇のそばに休憩所があります。まず三人でそこまで行き、休んでから戻る案なら、同じ経路を使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a rest area beside the flower bed on the map. If all three of you go there first, rest, and then return, you can take the same route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人が休憩所で待つ間、私だけ先へ行こうと思っていました。でも、一緒に戻るほうが話もしやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人を待たせず一緒に戻る方針を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was thinking of going farther on my own while my friend waited at the rest area. But returning together would make it easier to talk too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose to return together rather than leave your friend waiting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 待たせずに過ごしたいなら、その案が合いそうです。花壇までの道を図で確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you want to spend the time without making anyone wait, that plan seems suitable. Shall we check the way to the flower bed on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 花壇までの道を教えてください。並んで話したいので、細い道を避けられる経路を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 細い道を避けたい理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please show me the way to the flower bed. We want to walk side by side and talk, so I would like a route that avoids narrow paths.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain why you want to avoid narrow paths. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図では広い通路を通れますが、通行する人もいます。道をふさがないよう、混んでいれば一列になって歩いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The map shows a route along a wide path, but other people use it too. If it is crowded, please walk single file so you do not block the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ずっと並べるとは限らないのですね。人が多い所では一列になり、休憩所でゆっくり話すことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路をふさがず休憩所で話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So we may not be able to walk side by side the whole time. We will walk single file where there are many people and talk at leisure in the rest area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Talk at the rest area without blocking the path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 皆さんが戻る時期を決めておくと、歩く距離も調整しやすいですよ。休憩してから時間を見直す方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Deciding when everyone will return can help you adjust the walking distance. You could also review the time after taking a break.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休憩所で時計を見て、友人にも続けられるか聞きます。疲れていたら三人とも同じ道で入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三人で折り返す判断を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will check the clock at the rest area and ask my friend whether they can continue. If they are tired, all three of us will return to the entrance along the same path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Share the decision for all three of you to turn back together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 皆さんの希望を相談しながら歩けそうですね。休憩も楽しんで、仲間とよい時間をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: It sounds as though you can walk while discussing everyone's wishes. Enjoy your break too, and have a lovely time with your friends.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物が大きいですね。これからバスに乗る方でしょうか、それともお迎えをお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: That is a large bag. Are you about to take a bus, or are you waiting for someone to pick you up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: バスに乗ります。荷物を持ち上げるのが大変なので、階段を使わずに乗り場へ行ける道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重い荷物を持ち上げず乗り場に行きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am taking a bus. Lifting the bag is difficult, so I would like a way to the bus stand that does not involve stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to reach the bus stand without lifting your heavy bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの案内には何番の乗り場とありますか。番号を確かめてから、図で経路を探しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: What bus stand number is shown in your information? Let us check the number first, then find a route on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内では二番です。正面の階段が近そうですが、そちらへは行きたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二番へ行く際に正面の階段を選ばない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This information says stand 2. The stairs in front look close, but I do not want to go that way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid the front stairs when going to stand 2. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この図では、建物の横を回る通路が二番へ続いています。少し遠回りなので、出発までの時間も確認しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this map, the path around the side of the building leads to stand 2. It is a little farther, so let us also check how long you have before departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あと四十分あります。急いで荷物を運ぶより、遠回りでも自分で引いていける道を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 急ぐより荷物を引ける通路を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have another forty minutes. Rather than rush to carry the bag, I would prefer a route where I can pull it myself, even if it is longer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize a path where you can pull your bag over hurrying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、この線をたどる案を考えましょう。途中で通路が使えなければ、無理に進まず案内の係へ声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us consider following this line. If part of the path is unavailable, do not force your way through; ask the information staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通れない所があったら戻って相談します。乗り場に着いてから、荷物をどう置くかも聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 進めないときに戻り車内の置き方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I cannot get through somewhere, I will come back and ask. Once I reach the stand, can I also ask how to stow my bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Come back if you cannot continue, and check how to stow the bag on the bus. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 車内に持ち込むかなどは、利用するバスの係に確認してください。大きさや個数を伝えると相談しやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the staff for your bus whether to bring it on board and about other arrangements. Telling them its size and how many bags you have will help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 荷物はこの一個です。横の通路から二番へ向かい、乗る前にバスの係の方へ置き方を尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 横の通路から二番へ進んで係員に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is my only bag. I will take the side path to stand 2 and ask the bus staff where to put it before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the side path to stand 2 and ask the staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 時間を残して乗り場へ向かえそうですね。曲がり角では荷物が人に当たらないよう気をつけて、よい旅をお続けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: It looks as though you can reach the stand with time to spare. Be careful not to hit anyone with your bag at the corners, and enjoy the rest of your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入のご相談でしたら、前の住所で受け取った書類をお持ちですか。中身を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: If you are asking about registering after moving here, did you bring the documents you received at your previous address? Let us check what they contain together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋ごと持ってきましたが、兄の名前の紙も入っています。兄は引っ越さないので、私の分だけ手続きをしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 引越ししない兄の分を手続き対象から分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought the whole bag, but there is also a paper with my older brother's name. He is not moving, so I only want to complete my own procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Separate your brother's documents from the procedure because he is not moving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず宛名を見て分けましょう。袋に入っているからといって、すべてが今回の手続きに使う書類とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let us sort them by the names they are addressed to. Being in the bag does not necessarily mean every document is needed for this procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらの二枚は私の名前で、この一枚は兄です。兄の紙は別の封筒に戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の二枚と兄の一枚を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: These two sheets have my name, and this one has my brother's. I will put his paper back into a separate envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish your two sheets from your brother's one sheet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の分を担当窓口で確認しましょう。新しい住所は、お手元のメモや書類で確かめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check your documents at the responsible counter. Can you verify your new address using a note or document you have with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 部屋の契約書があります。ただ、建物名が長いので、住所を書くときに省略してよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 長い建物名の記入方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the rental agreement for my room. However, the building name is long, and I am unsure whether I may abbreviate it when writing the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check how to enter a long building name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記入する欄に合わせて、担当者へ表記を確認してください。ほかにも転入に伴って相談したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the staff member how to write it to suit the field on the form. Is there anything else related to your move that you would like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 保険のことも聞きたいです。会社で手続きをする予定ですが、何を役所に伝える必要があるかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自治体へ伝える必要事項を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would also like to ask about insurance. My company plans to handle the procedures, but I do not know what I need to tell the municipal office.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what information needs to be given to the municipality. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 加入の状況を担当者に説明して、必要な手続きがあるか確認しましょう。ここで一律に必要とも不要とも言うことはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Explain your enrollment situation to the staff member and check whether any procedures are needed. We cannot say here that everyone either needs them or does not.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社での手続きが予定だと伝えます。自分の書類と契約書を出し、住所の書き方と保険の相談先を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の書類で住所と保険の窓口相談へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that the company procedures are planned. I will present my own documents and rental agreement, and check how to write the address and where to ask about insurance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use your own documents to proceed with address and insurance inquiries at the counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人の分が整理できましたね。兄の書類を置き忘れず、担当窓口の案内を受けてからお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have sorted out your own documents. Please do not leave your brother's documents behind, and receive directions to the responsible counter before you go home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約のことでお話があると伺いました。いまの予定では来院が難しくなったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you would like to discuss your appointment. Has it become difficult to come at the scheduled time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族に送ってもらう予定でしたが、車を使えなくなりました。午前の予約を午後へ変えられるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 移動手段が予約相談の理由だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: A family member was going to drive me, but the car is no longer available. I would like to ask whether my morning appointment could be moved to the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that transportation is the reason for asking about the appointment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票を見せていただけますか。午後ならどの日でもよいのか、同じ日をご希望なのかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see your appointment slip? Please also tell me whether any afternoon would work, or whether you want the same day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ日の午後が第一希望です。別の日なら、家族の休みを確認してから返答したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返答できる候補と未確認の候補を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The afternoon of the same day is my first choice. If it is another day, I would like to check my family's days off before replying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish an option you can answer about from options you have not checked yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 希望を予約担当に伝えます。ところで、前回から体調に変わりはありませんか。症状の変化があれば、日時だけの相談にしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the appointment staff your preference. By the way, has your condition changed since last time? If your symptoms have changed, do not discuss only the date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日から咳が増えた気がします。車の都合だけを伝えるつもりでしたが、それも相談したほうがよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 交通事情だけで受診の時期を決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I feel I have been coughing more since yesterday. I was only going to explain the car problem, but I should discuss that too, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not decide when to seek care based only on transportation circumstances. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、変化があったことを担当者へ伝えます。受診を後にしてよいかは、ここで私から約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I will tell the responsible staff member that there has been a change. I cannot promise here that it is all right to delay your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午後にできるかだけでなく、咳が増えたことも伝えてください。自分でも、いつから変わったか説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更可否と体調の相談を一緒に扱う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please tell them not only that I want to know whether an afternoon appointment is possible, but also that my cough has increased. I will explain myself when it changed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss both whether the appointment can be changed and your condition. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにお話しください。予約の返答を受けるまで、元の予定が取り消されたと思わないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain it that way. Until you receive a reply about the appointment, do not assume that the original booking has been canceled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の予約はまだあると考え、担当者の返答を待ちます。別の日を提案されたら、家族と調整してから連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更成立前に予定を取り消したと思わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will consider the original appointment still in place and wait for the staff member's reply. If they suggest another day, I will coordinate with my family before contacting them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not assume the original booking is canceled before a change has been confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、予約票をお持ちになって担当へご相談ください。体調の変化も忘れずに伝えて、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take your appointment slip and consult the responsible staff member. Remember to mention the change in your condition, and take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないとのことですね。停めた場所は、何を目印に覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bicycle is missing, then. What landmark do you remember near where you parked it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駐輪場の時計の近くだと思います。ただ、よく似た列が二つあって、見たのは手前の列だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た二列のうち手前の列しか探していないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I think it was near the clock in the bicycle parking area. However, there are two very similar rows, and I only looked in the nearer one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have only searched the nearer of two similar rows. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ほかの列にないかは、まだ確かめていないのですね。最後に停めたときの写真や、位置がわかる情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you have not yet checked whether it is in another row. Do you have a photo from when you last parked it or any information showing the location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真はありません。後ろに植木があったことは覚えていますが、列の番号は見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真や列番号がない中で植木の記憶を補う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not have a photo. I remember some plants behind it, but I did not look at the row number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Add your memory of the plants, since you have no photo or row number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その記憶も記録しましょう。自転車自体を見分ける特徴と、鍵の状態を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us record that memory too. Please tell me what features identify the bicycle itself and whether it was locked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白い車体で、かごの左側が少しへこんでいます。鍵はかけました。防犯登録の書類は家にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自転車の識別に役立つ情報を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has a white frame, and the left side of the basket is slightly dented. I locked it. The bicycle registration documents are at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Organize the information that will help identify your bicycle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な情報は書類でも確認できます。管理者が移した可能性については、問い合わせをされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also check the necessary information in the documents. Have you asked whether the manager might have moved it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 管理者にはまだ聞いていません。盗まれたと決める前に、奥の列と移動の有無を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 盗難と決める前に別列と移動を調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not asked the manager yet. Before deciding it was stolen, I would like to check the back row and whether it was moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check another row and whether it was moved before concluding it was stolen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認結果を聞いて、状況に応じた相談を進めましょう。問い合わせのために、このメモへ目印をまとめておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us hear the results and then discuss what to do according to the situation. I will summarize the landmarks on this note for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 植木と時計の位置をメモに加えます。奥の列を見て管理者に尋ね、それでもなければ結果と登録書類を持って相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 管理者の回答と登録情報を相談に持参する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will add the positions of the plants and clock to the note. I will look in the back row and ask the manager; if it is still missing, I will bring the results and registration documents to seek advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bring the manager's answer and registration information when seeking advice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記憶と確認済みのことを分けて伝えてくださって助かりました。確認に向かわれる際は、周りの車にも気をつけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for distinguishing what you remember from what you have confirmed. When you go to check, please watch out for the cars around you too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒に入れた書類をお送りになるのですね。提出先から、送る方法の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending documents in an envelope. Has the recipient specified how they must be sent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 送ったことがわかる控えを残すよう言われました。それとは別に、金曜日までに届く必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 控えを残すことだけで送付条件を満たさないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told to keep a receipt showing that I sent them. Separately, they need to arrive by Friday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that keeping a receipt alone does not fulfill all the mailing requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送の記録と到着の期限は別の条件ですね。提出先の案内があれば、言葉を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Proof of dispatch and the arrival deadline are separate conditions. If you have the recipient's instructions, can we check the wording?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には金曜日必着とあります。金曜日に出せばよいと思っていましたが、到着する日なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送日と相手に届く日を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instructions say they must arrive by Friday. I thought I only needed to send them on Friday, but that is the arrival day, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the day of dispatch from the day they reach the recipient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、到着の条件を確認することが大切です。ただし、今から送って間に合うかは、宛先と取扱いを調べる必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, checking the arrival requirement is important. However, to know whether sending them now will be in time, we need to check the destination and service arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この住所へ送ります。控えが残る方法の中から、到着の見込みと料金を比べて選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 条件の合う送付方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am sending them to this address. Among methods that provide a receipt, I would like to compare the expected arrival and cost before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about mailing methods that meet the requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる方法を確認します。受付の控えに何が記載されるかも、提出先が求める記録と合うか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check which methods are available. Please also check what the acceptance receipt says and whether it matches the record required by the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付の控えだけで条件を満たすか、提出先に聞きます。追跡できることと、指定の控えがあることは同じとは限らないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追跡の有無だけで指定の記録と判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask the recipient whether the acceptance receipt alone meets their requirements. Being able to track it and having the specified receipt are not necessarily the same thing, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume that tracking alone provides the specified record. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうですね。確実な到着をここでお約束できない場合に備え、提出先に別の対応を相談することも考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is right. Please also consider asking the recipient about an alternative arrangement in case we cannot promise timely arrival here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内に合う控えかを確かめてから方法を選びます。間に合う見込みが立たなければ、提出先へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発送方法と提出先への相談を順に進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check whether the receipt matches the instructions before choosing a method. If there is no reasonable prospect of arriving in time, I will contact the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the mailing method and then consult the recipient in order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な条件を二つに分けて相談できましたね。発送されましたら控えを大切に保管して、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have been able to discuss the two requirements separately. Once you send it, please keep the receipt safely, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与の受取り用に口座をお考えなのですね。会社から受け取った案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are considering an account for receiving your salary. Do you have the information you received from your company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紙です。会社では短い呼び名を使っているので、口座もその名前で作るのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 略した名前をそのまま口座名義にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is this paper. I use a shortened name at work, so I thought I might open the account under that name too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Do not use a shortened name as the account holder's name without checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 呼び名と書類にある氏名は分けて考えましょう。本人確認の書類と、会社に登録した名前を担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us distinguish your usual name from the full name on your documents. The staff member will check your identity documents and the name registered with your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 在留カードの名前は長いのですが、会社の紙には後ろの部分がありません。違いを先に会社へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 長い正式氏名が省略された点を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The name on my residence card is long, but the company paper leaves out the last part. I would like to check that difference with the company first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Compare where your long official name has been abbreviated. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを説明していただくとよいですね。申込みに使える書類の条件も、ご本人の状況に合わせて担当者へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be good to explain that difference. Please also check with the staff member which documents can be used for the application in your own circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持っているのは在留カードと勤務先の書類です。これだけで足りると決めず、必要な物を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手元の二種だけで申込条件を満たすと決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my residence card and documents from my workplace. Rather than assume those are enough, I would like to ask what is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not assume that the two document types you have meet the application conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認した条件を整理してもらいましょう。口座ができたら、会社にどの情報を渡す必要があるかも案内に書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us have the confirmed requirements organized for you. Do the instructions also say what information you need to give your company once the account is open?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号と名義の欄がありますが、提出する日までは書かれていません。いつまでに出すのかも会社に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号と名義の提出日を職場に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are fields for the number and account holder's name, but no submission date. I will also ask the company when I need to submit them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask your workplace when to submit the number and account holder's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申込みの確認に時間がかかる場合もあります。会社の提出日が先にわかったとしても、その日までの開設をお約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Application checks can sometimes take time. Even if you learn the company's deadline first, we cannot promise the account will be open by then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社へ名前と提出日を確かめ、銀行では必要書類と申込みの流れを聞きます。できていない口座の情報は書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未開設の口座情報を先に書き込まず進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the name and submission date with the company, and ask the bank about the required documents and application process. I will not enter information for an account that has not been opened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed without filling in details for an account that is not yet open. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それぞれの確認先が整理できましたね。担当者の説明を受け、不明な箇所を確かめてからお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have sorted out which questions to ask where. Please receive the staff member's explanation and clarify any unclear points before going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 歯ブラシの棚でお迷いでしょうか。値札のどの部分がわかりにくいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble choosing at the toothbrush shelf? Which part of the price label is unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この値札を一本の値段だと思っていました。でも二本組の袋も並んでいて、どちらの値段かわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 何本分の価格か不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought this label was the price for one toothbrush. But there are also packs of two beside it, and I do not know which it refers to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that it is unclear how many toothbrushes the price covers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 値札にある商品名と本数を見比べましょう。この札は二本組の袋についた番号と同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare the product name and number of brushes on the label. This label has the same number as the one on the two-brush pack.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二本でその価格なのですね。一人分だけほしいので、一本売りのほうの値札も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人分の一本売りを比較したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So that price is for two. I only need one person's brush, so I would also like to check the label for the individually sold one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to compare an individually sold brush for one person. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一本売りはこちらの番号です。見た目が似ていても、毛の硬さなどが違う場合がありますので、商品も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the number for the individually sold brush. Even if they look similar, their bristle firmness and other features may differ, so please check the product too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 硬さが違うなら値段だけでは選べません。柔らかい物がほしいので、袋の表示を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本数と値段だけで歯ブラシを選ばない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: If their firmness differs, I cannot choose by price alone. I want a soft one, so I will read the package label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not choose a toothbrush based only on quantity and price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望の表示を見てから選ぶとよいですね。なお、この札の下には、割引の対象期間も書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is best to check the description you want before choosing. Also, the discount period is written at the bottom of this label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 割引が続いていると思い込まず、今日が対象の日か聞きたいです。対象でなければ通常の価格で比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期間が過ぎた割引を前提にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than assume the discount is still running, I would like to ask whether today is included. If not, I will compare the regular prices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not base your choice on a discount whose period has expired. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 期間と対象商品を確認します。ご購入の前に不明な値札を確かめていただければ、取り違えを避けやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check the period and which products qualify. Checking unclear labels before buying will make it easier to avoid mix-ups.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一本売りの柔らかい物に絞って、適用される価格を確認します。二本組の札を一本の札として計算しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二本組の札を誤って一本の計算に使わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will narrow it down to a soft brush sold individually and check the applicable price. I will not calculate the price for one using the label for a pair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not mistakenly use the two-brush label to calculate the price of one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本数と硬さの両方を確認できましたね。ご希望に合う品を選んで、ごゆっくりお買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have checked both the number of brushes and their firmness. Please choose something that suits you and take your time enjoying your shopping.
